scheme_name: Interest Subsidy Scheme for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Entrepreneurs
other_conditions: The business unit must be fully owned by SC/ST entrepreneurs; all promoters must belong to SC or ST community.
Any ownership or shareholding by persons other than SC/ST disqualifies the unit.
Entrepreneurs can belong to SC, ST, or both categories.
Units that have already received interest subsidy under any other Karnataka or India government scheme are ineligible.
The unit must not be in default on repayments to KSFC.
The interest subsidy is limited to loans up to ₹1,000 lakhs; interest on amounts beyond this is borne by the entrepreneur.
benefits_summary: Provides an interest subsidy with an effective rate of 4% on loans ranging from ₹20 lakhs to ₹1,000 lakhs, with repayment periods of up to 10 years.
